map.由质量数求核半径: Find the nuclear radius from the mass number
map.输入质量数 A，求原子核半径（r₀=1.2 fm）。: Enter the mass number A to get the nuclear radius (r₀ = 1.2 fm).
map.📖 查看「由质量数求核半径 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the nuclear radius from the mass number"
map.R = r₀·A^(1/3)，r₀≈1.2fm，由质量数 A 求核半径。: R = r₀·A^(1/3) with r₀ ≈ 1.2 fm gives the nuclear radius from the mass number A.
map.核密度、核反应截面估算。: Estimating nuclear density and reaction cross-sections.
map.对比不同 A 的核尺寸。: Compare nuclear sizes for different A.
map.若 A=208（Pb），则 R≈1.2e-15×5.92≈7.1 fm，核尺寸随: For A = 208 (Pb), R ≈ 1.2e-15 x 5.92 ≈ 7.1 fm; the nuclear size grows slowly with the cube root of A.
map.核体积与 A 成正比？: Is the nuclear volume proportional to A?
map.是，R∝A^(1/3) 故体积∝A，核密度近似常数，这是液滴模型基础。: Yes. Since R ∝ A^(1/3) the volume is proportional to A and the nuclear density is nearly constant, which underlies the liquid drop model.
map.约 1.2 fm，不同拟合（含电荷半径/物质半径）略有差异。: About 1.2 fm, with slight differences between fits such as charge radius and matter radius.
map.原子核半径（本页代码口径）：R=r₀×A^(1÷3)（m，r₀=1.2×10⁻¹: Nuclear radius (this page's code basis): R = r₀×A^(1÷3) (m, r₀ = 1.2×10⁻¹⁵ m i.e. 1.2 fm, A mass number, cube root taken as the real root); linked values: diameter = 2R, approximate nuclear volume = (4÷3)×π×R³ (fm³), nucleon number density = A÷volume (per fm³, with the volume floored at 10⁻⁹). Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; the volume is proportional to A, so nuclear matter density is approximately a constant independent of A.
map.校验：空值或非数值输入会提示并中止计算，不按 0 兜底；仅做非空与数值检查，不做: Validation: empty or non-numeric inputs trigger a prompt and abort the calculation — no zero fallback; only non-empty/numeric checks are performed, with no range validation.
